arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (current flips each leg). Pacer sets effort; I watch for: (1) pod drift (pod power vs boat-model power and heart rate diverging), (2) drag/weed vs a current or wind change (push_local drop in one leg only vs flipping with direction), (3) radio messages / course changes (set_race_distance + tell), (4) critical power wrong (heart rate trend vs pod power). Baseline window: race s 240-600. Check legs() at each turn. Save cues for real problems.

arguments.name: boat_pod_ratio
arguments.description: boat-model power over pod shaft power (share reaching boat as the computer sees it)

arguments.text: Start (1 min): pod 216 W vs CP 145, reserve 62%, HR 155, push +0.19 along leg 1. Hard start as expected. Calibration: boat CP 94 W, shaft CP 145 W (ratio 0.65).

Pacer eased at 110 s. Note: pacer has no push except finish (needs pod reserve >40% under 800 m) - a reserve of 10-40% near the end would go unspent; consider a + effort piece late.

PLAN: CP test piece +10% 240 s then 0% 120 s at start of leg 4 (~3050 m, after 35% so pacer ease rule is off). Rising HR all piece = CP near 145; HR plateau = CP higher.

Hold off the CP test until resolved.

Confirm on back leg 4 after the 3000 m turn: expected GPS ~2.75-2.78 at pod ~119 raw. If pod keeps drifting, re-fit gain. CP test piece still planned for leg 4.

Priced net -7 s (gain) as calibrated.

Late plan: at ~1000-800 m to go, if pod reserve 10-40%, use a + effort piece sized with test_cost to empty it by the finish.

arguments.text: RACE 9000 m (radio s 1239; paddler told). Legs of 1000 m: leg 8 (7000-8000 m) is BACK into the current (-0.21 m/s), leg 9 (8000-9000) is OUT with it. Fixed so far: pod_gain 0.81 since s 735 (pod reads low); weed cleared s 1800 (watch drag_again). CP ~145-148 (HR test). FINISH PLAN: computer says ~3.5 kJ pod reserve would be left unspent at the finish (pacer finish push needs >40%, it is ~24%). Spend it: (1) at ~7020 m piece +6% for 300 s (into current: each joule buys ~15% more time there); (2) at ~550 m to go, piece sized by test_cost to empty what is left by the line. Do not overspend before leg 9 in case CP is a bit low.
